camel_example: aliyun ossutil api delete-bucket-replication --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --replication-rules "{\"ID\":\"first-rule\"}"
description_en: Stops data replication for a bucket and deletes the replication configuration of the bucket. After this operation, any operations on the source bucket are no longer synchronized to the destination bucket
description_zh: 停止某个存储空间（Bucket）的数据复制并删除Bucket的复制配置，此时源Bucket中的任何操作都不会被同步到目标Bucket
name: DeleteBucketReplication
